BiblicalUsage: Agabah is the noun for that same inordinate love — amorousness, the lustful affection itself — and it appears only once, in Ezekiel's charge against Jerusalem: her sister Aholibah 'was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.' The word names the condition, not just the act: a heart given over to craving what God forbids.
TheologicalSignificance: I read this as a plain word doing plain work — its weight, if it has any, is borrowed from the verse around it; in this case, the verse is Ezekiel 23:11.
